column2: Forgive me for approaching you so abruptly, but...
are you the renowned Lord $$ヨハネ$$?!
$$バアル$$, the $$領主$$ of this city, wishes...
to invite all of you to dine with him.
Even if it is a trap, we must visit the $$領主$$'s mansion sooner or later...
